# Ready to Place

> Staffing agencies: get temporary workers HAZWOPER-certified before placement. Bulk seats for 40-hour, 24-hour, refresher and awareness courses, with guides on joint employer responsibilities.

Ready to Place (https://staffing-agencies.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs 40-Hour HAZWOPER, 24-Hour HAZWOPER, 8-Hour Refresher, First Responder Awareness or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://staffing-agencies.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA 40 Hour HAZWOPER Training](https://staffing-agencies.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training): $249.99 per seat, 40 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). For temps placed on cleanup sites. Enroll: https://staffing-agencies.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=587
- [OSHA 24 Hour HAZWOPER Training](https://staffing-agencies.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-24-hour-hazwoper-training): $169.99 per seat, 24 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e). For occasional and limited-exposure placements. Enroll: https://staffing-agencies.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-24-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=581
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Refresher Training](https://staffing-agencies.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training): $89.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e)(8). Keep your bench current. Enroll: https://staffing-agencies.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training?buy=595
- [OSHA 4-Hour HAZWOPER First Responder Awareness Level Training](https://staffing-agencies.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training): $61.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q)(6)(i). For warehouse and plant placements. Enroll: https://staffing-agencies.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-4-hour-hazwoper-first-responder-awareness-level-training?buy=1099
- [OSHA 24-Hour HAZWOPER - RCRA TSD Operations Training](https://staffing-agencies.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-24-hour-hazwoper-rcra-tsd-operations-training): $229.99 per seat, 24 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(p) / RCRA. For placements at treatment and disposal facilities. Enroll: https://staffing-agencies.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-24-hour-hazwoper-rcra-tsd-operations-training?buy=582

## Guides

- [Temp workers on HAZWOPER sites: who's responsible?](https://staffing-agencies.hazwoperosha.us/guides/temp-workers-who-is-responsible): OSHA treats staffing agencies and host employers as joint employers.
- [Getting HAZWOPER placements started fast](https://staffing-agencies.hazwoperosha.us/guides/getting-placements-started-fast): A checklist for agencies with a site start date coming up.
